Verdict: not-deploy-ready.

Positive: On the shipped build the runner class is gone, no runner lines appear at boot, and a real demo case stop still logged the live compliance evaluation.
Negative: Restarting the shipped build with compliance.results.process.enabled=true produced no runner activity and the app started normally.
Red check: Swapping the pre-fix runner and service classes into the container with the flag on made the startup backfill log for every tenant, then the shipped classes were restored and verified by checksum.

Blocker: The active dev, stage and prod task definitions still carry -Dcompliance.results.process.missing-only=true, which the ticket says to delete, and the MGB OpenShift flag check could not be done from here.

Automation: Existing RuleComplianceServiceGuardTest covers the live compliance path and nothing new is worth adding for a dead-code removal.
